title.narrative: Gestión y manejos comunitarios de bienes comunes para transición socioecológica

description.narrative:
The project "Community management and management of common goods for a fair and popular socio-ecological transition" will be implemented in rural territories of the departments of Antioquia, Cauca, Caquetá, Nariño, Putumayo and Santander, directly benefiting 1,500 people, and indirectly about 900,000. Indigenous peoples, Afro-descendant communities, peasants and their organizations will participate, prioritizing the participation of rural women and youth. The project will promote community-based management of water, energy, food and biodiversity from a climate, economic and gender justice perspective.
Practices, knowledge and organizational structures will be strengthened, recognizing the central role of local communities in the defense of the territory in the face of the climate crisis and extractivism. In addition, political training, research, advocacy and communication strategies will be consolidated to position community models as real solutions to the polycrisis. The project also contemplates the institutional strengthening of Censat, improving its governance, operational structure and financial sustainability
